    The line node from interval-finiteness and the core step #

    LineNode (all finite convex pieces representation-finite ⇒ monomial band) follows from

    • HullNode: every finite set of objects of the universal cover lies in a finite convex piece (interval-finiteness), and
    • D7Node: if all finite convex pieces are representation-finite and graded-indecomposable k(P)-modules have supports of unbounded size, there is a monomial band.

    The link is Gabriel's covering theorem (repFin_of_bounded_support): bounded supports would make k(P) ≅ B representation-finite.
